Manim module: animation.animation (category: animations)
Animate mobjects.
Classes:
  - Animation: An animation.
  - Wait: A "no operation" animation.
  - Add: Add Mobjects to a scene, without animating them in any other way. This
Functions:
  - prepare_animation(): Returns either an unchanged animation, or the animation built
  - override_animation(): Decorator used to mark methods as overrides for specific Animation types.

Manim module: animation.changing (category: animations)
Animation of a mobject boundary and tracing of points.
Classes:
  - AnimatedBoundary: Boundary of a VMobject with animated color change.
  - TracedPath: Traces the path of a point returned by a function call.

Manim module: animation.composition (category: animations)
Tools for displaying multiple animations at once.
Classes:
  - AnimationGroup: Plays a group or series of Animation.
  - Succession: Plays a series of animations in succession.
  - LaggedStart: Adjusts the timing of a series of Animation according to lag_ratio.
  - LaggedStartMap: Plays a series of Animation while mapping a function to submobjects.

Manim module: animation.creation (category: animations)
Animate the display or removal of a mobject from a scene.
Classes:
  - ShowPartial: Abstract class for Animations that show the VMobject partially.
  - Create: Incrementally show a VMobject.
  - Uncreate: Like Create but in reverse.
  - DrawBorderThenFill: Draw the border first and then show the fill.
  - Write: Simulate hand-writing a Text or hand-drawing a VMobject.
  - Unwrite: Simulate erasing by hand a Text or a VMobject.
  - SpiralIn: Create the Mobject with sub-Mobjects flying in on spiral trajectories.
  - ShowIncreasingSubsets: Show one submobject at a time, leaving all previous ones displayed on screen.
  - AddTextLetterByLetter: Show a Text letter by letter on the scene.
  - RemoveTextLetterByLetter: Remove a Text letter by letter from the scene.
  - ShowSubmobjectsOneByOne: Show one submobject at a time, removing all previously displayed ones from screen.
  - AddTextWordByWord: Show a Text word by word on the scene. Note: currently broken.
  - TypeWithCursor: Similar to AddTextLetterByLetter , but with an additional cursor mobject at the end.
  - UntypeWithCursor: Similar to RemoveTextLetterByLetter , but with an additional cursor mobject at the end.

Manim module: animation.growing (category: animations)
Animations that introduce mobjects to scene by growing them from points.

  - GrowArrow: Introduce an Arrow by growing it from its start toward its tip.
  - SpinInFromNothing: Introduce an Mobject spinning and growing it from its center.

Manim module: animation.indication (category: animations)

  - ShowPassingFlashWithThinningStrokeWidth: (no description)
  - ApplyWave: Send a wave through the Mobject distorting it temporarily.
  - Wiggle: Wiggle a Mobject.
  - Circumscribe: Draw a temporary line surrounding the mobject.
  - Blink: Blink the mobject.

Manim module: animation.transform (category: animations)
Animations transforming one mobject into another.
Classes:

  - ReplacementTransform: Replaces and morphs a mobject into a target mobject.
  - TransformFromCopy: Performs a reversed Transform

  - CounterclockwiseTransform: Transforms the points of a mobject along a counterclockwise oriented arc.
  - MoveToTarget: Transforms a mobject to the mobject stored in its target attribute.

  - ApplyPointwiseFunctionToCenter: (no description)

  - ShrinkToCenter: Animation that makes a mobject shrink to center.
  - Restore: Transforms a mobject to its last saved state.
  - ApplyFunction: (no description)

  - ApplyComplexFunction: (no description)
  - CyclicReplace: An animation moving mobjects cyclically.
  - Swap: (no description)
  - TransformAnimations: (no description)
  - FadeTransform: Fades one mobject into another.
  - FadeTransformPieces: Fades submobjects of one mobject into submobjects of another one.
